subject.title: fix(sandbox): bound SSH command output buffering at 16 MiB

question: Should SSH sandbox commands intentionally use a 16 MiB per-stream ceiling instead of the current shared 100 MiB sandbox command limit?
rationale: Current main already resolves the unbounded-buffering problem, leaving a compatibility and cross-backend contract decision that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Keep shared limit
options.body: Retain the existing bounded 100 MiB contract across sandbox backends and close this SSH-only tightening.

options.title: Approve SSH-specific limit
options.body: Accept that SSH commands above 16 MiB per stream will fail while sibling sandbox paths keep the shared ceiling.

recommendation.title: Keep shared limit
recommendation.body: Retain the existing bounded 100 MiB contract across sandbox backends and close this SSH-only tightening.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person to the core SSH sandbox introduction and repeated maintenance of the command path.
